Download the archive for your system, extract it, and run `liars_dice` (`liars_dice.exe` on Windows).

- Windows, 64-bit: the file ending in `windows-x86_64.zip`
- macOS 13.3 or later, Apple Silicon and Intel: the file ending in `macos-universal.tar.gz`
- Linux x86_64 with glibc 2.39 or later (Ubuntu 24.04, Fedora 40, or newer), X11 or Wayland: the file ending in `linux-x86_64.tar.gz`

These builds aren't signed. On macOS, run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine liars_dice` in the extracted folder before the first launch, or allow it under System Settings → Privacy & Security after the first blocked attempt. On Windows, if SmartScreen warns, choose "More info", then "Run anyway".
